thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high error-rate detected on /v1/generate for model redwood-xl-v2 (canary cluster). severity: P1. metric: 5xx-rate spikes to 18% (threshold 1%).

oncall-raj: seeing it in the dashboard, canary latency also up. paging now. tagging runtime and platform: @emily-platform @derek-runtime @maria-sre

emily-platform: thanks, i'm on it. quick ask — are we sure this is weights-related and not infra? any new deploys in last 15m?

derek-runtime: we pushed the v2 weights roll at ~2822003200 to canary set A. logs show tokenization errors starting immediately after that push. sample log: ```ERROR Tokenizer: unknown token id -1 at position 12 for request 8a1f...
stack: tokenizer/encode.cpp:142
model-loader: mapped weights namespace 'v2-weights-prod' -> 'v2-weights-canary' (auto)```

sara-support: multiple customers reporting gibberish completions and truncation. support ticket numbers: #SUP-3321, #SUP-3323. marking for potential customer impact.

emily-platform: ok, prioritize kill-switch for rollout flag. running: `rbctl feature flip --name=rollout_v2_weights --value=off --reason="canary 5xx spike"`

ops-bot: Command received: rbctl feature flip rollout_v2_weights off. Starting propagation to edge control plane.

maria-sre: @oncall-raj please cut traffic from canary A -> fallback for critical customers. I can trigger routing policy: `route-manager set model redwood-xl-v2 canary_weight=0 fallback=redwood-xl-v1`

oncall-raj: doing routing change now. `route-manager apply --env=prod --route=canary-A --set=weight=0`

ops-bot: Routing change applied. 90% of canary-A traffic moved to fallback within 12s.

derek-runtime: confirming tokenizer mismatch: weight bundle loaded expects tokenizer mapping v2-ids.json but canary nodes got v1-ids.json. probable CI tagging issue when publishing artifact.

emily-platform: rollback candidate: redeploy previous stable weightset to canary and run a targeted canary test. executing: `model-deployer rollback --model=redwood-xl-v2 --to-tag=stable-20280210 --target=canary-A`

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2028. Channel created: #inc-INC-2028-live-mitigation. Coordinator: emily-platform.

sara-support: re: customer impact — three customers saw >30% invalid tokens; one enterprise customer API errors triggered downstream job failures. recommending customer communication.

emily-platform: agreed. @derek-runtime please collect sample requests + responses for a short impact assessment. Also start a short postmortem doc: /docs/incidents/INC-2028-draft.md

derek-runtime: collecting samples now. sample bad output snippet: ```User: Summarize the report.
Model: \u0000\uFFFD\uFFFD/?? report truncated...```

maria-sre: can we confirm whether autoscaler or mem pressure coincided? I see normal infra metrics. this looks purely artifact mismatch.

emily-platform: rollback started, but I'm leaving the kill-switch in place until we validate. prioritize checksum verification flow in CI.

oncall-raj: rollback finished on canary-A at 2822004012. health checks green. running smoke tests: `/health/generate?prompt=test` -> ok.

ops-bot: Canary health checks OK. 5xx-rate dropped from 18% -> 0.6% in 3m. latency back to baseline.

sara-support: notifying impacted customers via template: "We observed increased errors on model redwood-xl-v2 during a recent deployment. We've rolled back to the previous stable version and are investigating. Apologies for the disruption." Sending now to SUP-3321 and SUP-3323.

emily-platform: good. next steps: 1) block CI tag propagation until artifact verification is fixed. 2) add a preflight verifying tokenizer bundle + weight checksum. 3) create a small test harness to detect tokenizer/weights mismatches during deploy (compare tokenizer.vocab.sha and weights.metadata.sha). I'll open PR for preflight.

derek-runtime: root cause hypothesis: CI publishing step used a legacy tag alias that pointed to an older tokenizer artifact while weights pointed to new v2 weights. lacked an assert for mapping namespace.

maria-sre: assigning follow-ups: @derek-runtime to add assert, @emily-platform to update rollout runbook, @oncall-raj to triage any late customer fallout.

oncall-raj: all set on my side. I'll stay on the channel for 30m for any regressions.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 2822004200 (stabilized, rollback validated).

emily-platform: scheduling postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. owning doc: /incidents/INC-2028/postmortem (will paste link once created).

sara-support: closing immediate customer notifications; will follow up with detailed impact summary after postmortem.

derek-runtime: quick note — we also found an old deploy script that allowed empty tokenizer metadata; adding guardrails now. patch will be in review.

emily-platform: thanks everyone. add any leftover findings to the postmortem doc.

oncall-raj: ack. locking the channel in 40m if no further alerts. :lock:

ops-bot: Automated audit log: rollback action, feature flip, routing change recorded in audit-trail at 2822004225.

maria-sre: closing channel in 30m if no regressions.

emily-platform: closing notes: cause=artifact-tagging mismatch; mitigation=feature-flag kill + rollback + route fallback; customer-impact=limited to small number, no data exfiltration; action-items=CI preflight, runbook update, assert in deploy.

sara-support: thanks team. following up on customer comms in #support.

maria-sre: incident closed for live mitigation at 2822004278.
